# moq_project (Resource)

A MoQ Pro project: a namespace for broadcasts with its own keys, recordings, usage, and bill.

An account can own a limited number of projects. If a create is refused for that limit, [ask support](mailto:support@moq.pro) to raise it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "moq_project" "example" {
  name             = "example"
  spend_cap_micros = 100000000 # USD 100 per month

  public = {
    subscribe = ["demo/**"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_access` (Boolean) Admit members with a verified email address on the token owner's domain.
- `domain_role` (String) Role granted to domain members: `read` or `write`.
- `name` (String) Optional vanity name, 4 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, and inner hyphens. A rename keeps the old name as a redirect and locks further renames for seven days.
- `public` (Attributes) Anonymous access: broadcast path patterns anyone may publish or subscribe to without a token. A bare path matches exactly; a trailing `**` segment matches its subtree. Omit for no anonymous access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public))
- `spend_cap_micros` (Number) Monthly spending cap in micro-USD (1000000 is USD 1), from USD 1 to USD 1,000,000. Omit for no cap.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `domain` (String) The verified email domain admitted when `domain_access` is on.
- `id` (String) Immutable project ID, used in API paths and relay URLs.

<a id="nestedatt--public"></a>
### Nested Schema for `public`

Optional:

- `publish` (Set of String) Patterns anyone may publish to.
- `subscribe` (Set of String) Patterns anyone may subscribe to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the immutable project ID.
terraform import moq_project.example p123example
```
